note: ADR 1018: the legal programs whose checker violation sits at a site no run reaches (legal.mjs outcome `unexecuted`) that a person has seen. Such a row needs a look (codes.mjs `rowProblem`: `unexecuted-violation`) unless an entry below matches its grid and id: `explained` (the judge is right that the site never runs and the row is not a checker defect, a lane that never drives the site, say) or `pending-fix` (a real false positive whose fix is the ADR named, held so CI stays green until it lands; the fix's change removes the entry), or `known-false-positive` (ADR 1033: a real false positive no exact fact can rule out, its ADR saying why). A provably dead site gives U, never V (ADR 1018 retires the 2026-11-10 "wrong if it runs" ruling). Seeded from the full audit at 78ddeb849 (run 43739577046): 6,205 rows in lg-recall, four groups, each Chrome-confirmed on 993e83f74.

entries.why: `document.querySelectorAll("sc-no-such-tag").forEach(f)`: the generated page holds no such element, so Chrome never runs `f`, but no exact fact says the document holds none (its HTML, the project, a package or an extension may add one): the checker keeps the violation (5 rows: SC2001 x3, SC2002, SC3002).
